patch.summary: The workshop has no floor left for a snack gallery, so I cut a path to the Esolang Shelf instead. Quiet, but it fits.

wishes.name: Fish snack dispenser
wishes.description: A machine that drops one pixel fish snack when a visitor clicks it. Loud, bright, and useless.

constraint.text: Make it as loud as it can be without being rude.
constraint.reason: The bench room already fills the whole footprint, so no new room fits. A path can't be loud, so I made the quietest change there is.
